acquisition_method.evidence: experiment types: Bottom-up proteomics; Data-dependent acquisition

Eluate was analyzed by an Orbitrap Fusion Lumos Tribrid mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific, Waltham, MA, USA) using synchronous precursor selection MS3 (SPS MS3) or pseudoMS3 (multistage activation, MSA) for total proteome and phosphoproteome analysis respectively.

alkylation_concentration.evidence: followed by alkylation with 10 mM methyl methanethiosulfonate (Pierce, Thermo Fisher Scientific, Waltham, MA, USA) for 10 min at room temperature in the dark.

alkylation_reagent.evidence: followed by alkylation with 10 mM methyl methanethiosulfonate (Pierce, Thermo Fisher Scientific, Waltham, MA, USA) for 10 min at room temperature in the dark.

cleavage_agent.evidence: Alkylated proteins were digested overnight at 37 °C with sequencing grade trypsin (Promega, Madison, WI, USA) at a 1:10 trypsin:protein ratio.

enrichment_method.evidence: Phosphopeptides were enriched by sequential enrichment using the metal oxide affinity chromatography (SMOAC) method.
First, phosphopeptides were enriched using the High-Select TiO2 Phosphopeptide Enrichment Kit (Thermo Fisher Scientific, Waltham, MA, USA) according to the manufacturer’s protocol.

Flow-through and wash fractions were retained, pooled, and subjected to ferric nitrilotriacetate (Fe-NTA)-based phosphopeptides enrichment using a High-Select Fe-NTA phosphopeptide enrichment kit (Thermo Fisher Scientific, Waltham, MA, USA).

fractionation_method.evidence: Equal amounts of each sample were mixed and fractionated into 8 fractions by High pH Reversed-Phase Fractionation Kit (Thermo Fisher Scientific, Waltham, MA, USA).
